The Founder

Sifu Sultan Assad Abd-Al-Ghalib

Pedro Barros — martial artist, teacher, and founder of the Yangyiquan system. Trained in China's martial lineages and self-healing arts.

Sifu Sultan Assad
Abd-Al-Ghalib
Pedro Barros · Founder · Head Instructor

Pedro Barros has spent more than two decades studying Chinese internal and external martial arts under verified lineages. Under Shifu Diogo Sant'Ana, he trained in Yang Taijiquan, Chen Taijiquan and Nanquan. Under Sensei Carmindo Paiva, he deepened his foundations in Karate Shukokai.

From this rigorous base he developed a personal synthesis — Yangyiquan — a living system that he continues to refine through daily practice and teaching. The system is honestly presented as a work in active development, not a closed canon.

Based in Granada, Andalusia, Spain. The Yangyiquan Kung Fu Self Defense Association International is in its early institutional phase.

Yang Taijiquan · Chen Taijiquan · Nanquan — under Shifu Diogo Sant'Ana
Karate Shukokai — under Sensei Carmindo Paiva
Certified: Shiatsu · Sports Massage · Pranic Healing (Level 1)
Founder — Yangyiquan Kung Fu SDA International

The System

Philosophy · The Three Pillars

Like many Chinese martial traditions, Yangyiquan organizes its work around three interconnected principles. The Sifu's specific synthesis and naming defines the system's character.

意
Yi · 意 — Intention
The leading force of any movement. Without clear intention, technique becomes mechanical. ◆ CLICK TO LEARN
气
Qi · 气 — Vital Energy
Cultivated through breath, posture and presence. The Dan Tian is its primary reservoir. Directed by Yi, expressed as Fajin. ◆ CLICK TO LEARN
丹田
Dan Tian · 丹田 — Centre
Three energetic centres. The lower is the source of all physical power and the origin of Fajin. ◆ CLICK TO LEARN
◆ FROM THE 3-VOLUME DOSSIER ◆

"Yangyiquan is not a finished collection of techniques. It is a living practice — one that I continue to study, refine and share. What I offer is what I know, honestly transmitted."

— Sifu Sultan Assad Abd-Al-Ghalib

The 9 Internal Powers

Nei Gong · 内功

Nine Internal Powers articulated by the Sifu — the psychological, spiritual and tactical foundation that distinguishes Yangyiquan from conventional martial arts. Click any card to explore.

EXTREME POWERS · 极端力量
Extreme I
應
Yi Jing · The Already-Is
Omniscient Reality · Supreme Knowledge
The highest power. Seeing reality as it truly is — without ego distortion. Omniscient martial vision through purified mind and deep Nei Gong.
Extreme II
天
Tiān · Heaven
Celestial Forces · Prophecy · Universal Law
Alignment with universal laws of justice. Celestial intuition — perceiving the adversary's intention before it materializes.
Extreme III
地磁
Dì Cí · Earth-Magnet
Grounding · Stability · Fajin Source
Absorbing Earth Qi through the feet, storing in the Dan Tian, releasing as explosive Fajin. Foundation of all devastating techniques.
Extreme IV
地獄
Dì Yù · The Underworld
Hidden Forces · Shadow Transformation
Mastery over hidden dark forces. Absorbing and redirecting destructive energy — returning it against its source.
INTERMEDIATE POWERS · 中间力量
Intermediate I
神識
Shén Shí · The Heart
Martial Empathy · Emotional Perception
Sensing the adversary's emotional space from within. Reading motivation, not just movement. Foundation of the Dao Zhiliao healing art.
Intermediate II
創造
Chuāng Zào · Creation
Observe · Create · Originality
Observing nature to extract martial principles. Creating original techniques. Originality as the primary tactical advantage in combat.
Intermediate III
斬
Zhǎn · The Cut
Liberation · Decisive Strike
Severing negative energetic bonds. Physically: the decisive cutting strike. Spiritually: liberation from what weakens before combat.
Intermediate IV
寶
Bǎo · Hidden Treasure
Qi · Information · Breath as Weapon
Qi as information. Absorbing the adversary's Yang at the critical moment. Karma as battlefield — justice multiplies effective power.
Intermediate V
至
Zhì · The Immortal
Yin-Yang Mastery · Total Integration
Complete mastery of all polarities. The integration of Yin and Yang into unified consciousness — the state the tradition calls the Immortal.
